# anthropic_workspace (Data Source)

Looks up a single Claude Console workspace by `id` or `name` (`/v1/organizations/workspaces`).



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Unique identifier of the workspace (`wrkspc_...`). Exactly one of `id` or `name` must be set.
- `name` (String) Display name of the workspace. Exactly one of `id` or `name` must be set.

### Read-Only

- `archived_at` (String) RFC 3339 timestamp when the workspace was archived, or `null` if active.
- `created_at` (String) RFC 3339 timestamp when the workspace was created.
- `data_residency` (Attributes) Data residency settings of the workspace. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--data_residency))
- `display_color` (String) Display color of the workspace.
- `type` (String) Object type (`workspace`).

<a id="nestedatt--data_residency"></a>
### Nested Schema for `data_residency`

Read-Only:

- `allowed_inference_geos` (Set of String) Allowed geographies for model inference.
- `default_inference_geo` (String) Default geography for model inference.
- `workspace_geo` (String) Geographic region where workspace data is stored at rest.
